propositions: Canonical `rebar bridge status` and hidden alias `rebar bridge-status` must be identical read-only endpoints using the same parser and core with identical options, output, errors, and exits.

A single process-finalizer writer records minimal authoritative JSON to `refs/reconciler/last-pass` before releasing the lock, with exactly three bounded CAS attempts (100ms/200ms delays) and clear operational failure when all retries exhaust.
Status verdict precedence is PAUSED > RUNNING > FOREIGN > FAILED > STALE > HEALTHY with NEVER_RUN only when no record and no live lock; exit codes and facts are precisely specified per verdict.

Identity continuity for writer and status uses explicit REBAR_ENV_ID if set, otherwise derives stable `local:<repo-env-id>` from checkout `.env-id`; missing/empty/.env-id is a hard error never falling back to reconciler.

The production canary moves from GitHub Actions heartbeat polling to durable last-pass status, with explicit `REBAR_CANARY_HEARTBEAT_SOURCE=github-api` rollback for one release and detection of stalled fence via two read-only snapshots across the lock-held lease.

Rich detail in `.tickets-tracker/.bridge_state/last-pass.json` is one rolling file safely degraded when absent or mismatched; status includes detail only when pass and environment ids match the authoritative ref.
